wikidot5e:spell:absorb-elements.name: Absorb Elements
wikidot5e:spell:absorb-elements.casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage
wikidot5e:spell:absorb-elements.description: You gain resistance to the triggering acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage type until the start of your next turn. wikidot5e:spell:animal-friendship.name: Animal Friendship
wikidot5e:spell:animal-friendship.description: Choose a beast in range that can see and hear you. If its Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails; otherwise it makes a Wisdom save and is charmed by you for the duration on a failure. The charm ends if you or one of your companions harms it. A slot above 1st lets you affect one additional beast per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:animal-messenger.name: Animal Messenger
wikidot5e:spell:animal-messenger.description: Choose a Tiny beast in range and name a location you have visited, a generally described recipient, and a spoken message of no more than 25 words. The beast travels toward that location for the duration at about 50 miles per 24 hours if it flies or 25 miles otherwise. On arrival it delivers the message in your voice only to a creature matching the description. If it does not arrive before the spell ends, the message is lost and it returns toward the casting location. A slot above 2nd adds 48 hours of duration per slot level.

components: M (an agate worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
wikidot5e:spell:awaken.description: Touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant whose Intelligence is absent or 3 or lower. It gains Intelligence 10 and the ability to speak one language you know. wikidot5e:spell:blight.description: One creature you can see in range makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Undead and constructs are unaffected. A plant creature or magical plant saves with disadvantage and takes maximum damage instead of rolled damage. A nonmagical plant that is not a creature gets no save and immediately withers and dies. Each slot level above 4th adds 1d8 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:call-lightning.name: Call Lightning
wikidot5e:spell:call-lightning.description: Create a storm cloud directly above you, a 10-foot-tall cylinder with a 60-foot radius centered on a visible point in range; if you cannot see a location in the air that can contain it, the spell fails. On casting, choose a visible point beneath the cloud: each creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. On each later turn you can use your action to call another bolt at the same or a different point beneath the cloud. If cast outdoors during stormy weather, you control the existing storm instead and each bolt deals an extra 1d10. Each slot level above 3rd adds another 1d10 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:commune-with-nature.name: Commune with Nature
wikidot5e:spell:commune-with-nature.description: Gain knowledge of natural territory within 3 miles outdoors or 300 feet in caves and similar natural underground settings. The spell does not function where construction has replaced nature, such as towns or dungeons. Instantly learn up to three facts you choose concerning terrain and water; prevalent plants, minerals, animals, or peoples; powerful celestials, fey, fiends, elementals, or undead; planar influences; or buildings.

wikidot5e:spell:confusion.name: Confusion
wikidot5e:spell:confusion.description: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered within range make Wisdom saves when you cast; failures cannot take reactions and roll 1d10 at the start of each turn for behavior. On 1, use all movement in a random direction determined with a d8 and take no action. On 2–6, neither move nor act. On 7–8, use the action to make a melee attack against a random creature within reach, doing nothing if none is reachable. On 9–10, move and act normally. At the end of each turn an affected creature repeats the Wisdom save, ending the effect on a success. Each slot level above 4th increases the sphere radius by 5 feet.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-animals.name: Conjure Animals
wikidot5e:spell:conjure-animals.description: Summon fey spirits in beast form into visible unoccupied spaces in range, choosing one CR 2-or-lower beast, two CR 1-or-lower beasts, four CR 1/2-or-lower beasts, or eight CR 1/4-or-lower beasts. Each is also fey and disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. They are friendly to you and your companions, share an initiative group with their own turns, and obey your verbal commands without requiring your action. Without commands they defend themselves but otherwise take no actions; the DM supplies their statistics. Using a 5th-level slot doubles the number summoned, a 7th-level slot triples it, and a 9th-level slot quadruples it.

wikidot5e:spell:conjure-elemental.name: Conjure Elemental
components: M (burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur and phosphorus for fire, or water and sand for water)
wikidot5e:spell:conjure-elemental.description: Choose a 10-foot cube of air, earth, fire, or water in range and summon an appropriate CR 5-or-lower elemental into an unoccupied space within 10 feet of that area. It disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends. While you maintain concentration it is friendly, has its own initiative, and obeys verbal commands without requiring your action; without commands it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. If concentration breaks, it remains for the rest of the 1-hour summoning period, becomes hostile to you and your companions, may attack, and cannot be dismissed by you. The DM supplies its statistics. Each slot level above 5th raises the maximum CR by 1.

wikidot5e:spell:contagion.name: Contagion
wikidot5e:spell:contagion.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature in reach; on a hit it becomes poisoned. At the end of each of its turns while poisoned, it makes a Constitution save. Three successes end the poison and the spell; three failures end the poison but inflict one chosen natural disease for the remainder of the 7-day duration, so effects that remove or mitigate disease work normally. Blinding Sickness: disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saves, and blinded. Filth Fever: disadvantage on Strength checks, Strength saves, and Strength-based attacks. Flesh Rot: disadvantage on Charisma checks and vulnerability to all damage. Mindfire: disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saves and, in combat, behavior as under confusion. Seizure: disadvantage on Dexterity checks, Dexterity saves, and Dexterity-based attacks. Slimy Doom: disadvantage on Constitution checks and saves, and whenever the creature takes damage it is stunned until the end of its next turn.

wikidot5e:spell:control-flames.name: Control Flames
wikidot5e:spell:control-flames.description: Choose visible nonmagical flame in range that fits within a 5-foot cube and apply one option: instantly extend it 5 feet in one direction if fuel is present there; instantly extinguish the flames in the cube; for 1 hour double or halve its bright- and dim-light areas, change its color, or both; or for 1 hour create and animate simple shapes in the flames. You can have at most three noninstantaneous effects from repeated castings active at once and may dismiss one as an action.

wikidot5e:spell:control-water.name: Control Water
components: M (a drop of water and a pinch of dust)
wikidot5e:spell:control-water.description: Control freestanding water in a cube up to 100 feet on a side for the duration, choosing an effect when cast and using an action on later turns to repeat it or switch effects. Flood raises standing water by up to 20 feet, spilling over shores; in a large body it instead creates a 20-foot-high wave crossing the area, carrying Huge-or-smaller vehicles to the far side and giving each struck Huge-or-smaller vehicle a 25% capsize chance. Raised water persists until the spell ends or you change effects; a created wave repeats at the start of your next turn while Flood remains active. Part Water creates a trench across the area with walls of separated water; when the effect ends or changes, the trench refills over the next round. Redirect Flow makes flowing water move in any chosen direction, including over obstacles or uphill, while inside the area; once outside it resumes terrain-driven flow. Whirlpool requires water at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep and creates a central vortex 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet high. Creatures and objects in the water within 25 feet are pulled 10 feet toward it; a creature can swim away with a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. A creature entering the vortex for the first time on a turn or starting there makes a Strength save, taking 2d8 bludgeoning damage and becoming caught on a failure, or half damage without being caught on a success. A caught creature can use an action to swim away but makes that Athletics check with disadvantage. An object takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage the first time each turn it enters the vortex and again each round it remains there.

wikidot5e:spell:control-winds.name: Control Winds
wikidot5e:spell:control-winds.description: Control air in a visible 100-foot cube. Choose an effect when cast; on later turns use an action to switch effects, halt the current effect, or restart a halted one. Gusts creates horizontal wind in a chosen direction at calm, moderate, or strong intensity; moderate or strong wind imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks passing through or targeting within the cube, and strong wind costs creatures moving against it 1 extra foot of movement per foot traveled. Downdraft creates strong downward wind, imposes the same ranged-attack disadvantage, and forces a flying creature entering the cube for the first time on a turn or starting there to make a Strength save or fall prone. Updraft makes creatures ending a fall in the cube take half falling damage and lets creatures in the cube jump vertically up to 10 feet higher than normal.

Destroy Water removes up to 10 gallons from an open container or destroys fog in a 30-foot cube. Each slot level above 1st adds 10 gallons or increases the cube by 5 feet per side.

wikidot5e:spell:cure-wounds.name: Cure Wounds
wikidot5e:spell:cure-wounds.description: A creature you touch regains 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. The spell has no effect on undead or constructs. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d8 healing.

wikidot5e:spell:darkvision.name: Darkvision
components: M (either a pinch of dried carrot or an agate)
wikidot5e:spell:darkvision.description: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.
wikidot5e:spell:darkvision.sourceDescription: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

wikidot5e:spell:daylight.name: Daylight
wikidot5e:spell:daylight.description: A point in range emits bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for another 60 feet. If placed on an object you hold or an unattended object, the light moves with it; completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. Where this light overlaps darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the darkness spell is dispelled.

wikidot5e:spell:detect-magic.name: Detect Magic
wikidot5e:spell:detect-magic.description: For the duration, sense whether magic is present within 30 feet. If magic is sensed, you can use an action to see a faint aura around visible magical creatures or objects in the area and learn the school of magic, if any. The detection penetrates most barriers but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

wikidot5e:spell:detect-poison-and-diseas.name: Detect Poison and Disease
wikidot5e:spell:detect-poison-and-diseas.description: For the duration, sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet and identify the kind in each case. The detection penetrates most barriers but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

wikidot5e:spell:dispel-magic.name: Dispel Magic
wikidot5e:spell:dispel-magic.description: Choose a creature, object, or magical effect in range. Every spell of 3rd level or lower on it ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher, make a spellcasting-ability check against DC 10 + that spell's level; on a success it ends. If you use a slot of 4th level or higher, a spell on the target ends automatically when its level is no higher than the slot you used.

wikidot5e:spell:dominate-beast.name: Dominate Beast
wikidot5e:spell:dominate-beast.description: A visible beast in range makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it, or is charmed for the duration. While charmed and on the same plane, you share a telepathic link and can issue simple general commands while conscious without an action; once an order is completed and no new direction is given, it defends and preserves itself. You can use your action to take total precise control until the end of your next turn, choosing all its actions and using your own reaction if you make it use a reaction. Whenever it takes damage it repeats the Wisdom save, ending the spell on a success. A 5th-level slot lasts up to 10 minutes, 6th up to 1 hour, and 7th or higher up to 8 hours, all with concentration.

wikidot5e:spell:druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
wikidot5e:spell:druidcraft.description: Create one minor nature effect in range: a harmless sensory sign lasting 1 round that predicts local weather for the next 24 hours; instantly make a flower blossom, seed pod open, or leaf bud bloom; create an instantaneous harmless sensory effect fitting within a 5-foot cube; or instantly light or extinguish a candle, torch, or small campfire.

wikidot5e:spell:dust-devil.name: Dust Devil
wikidot5e:spell:dust-devil.description: Create a dust devil in a visible unoccupied 5-foot cube. A creature ending its turn within 5 feet makes a Strength save, taking 1d8 bludgeoning damage and being pushed 10 feet away on a failure, or half damage without the push on a success. As a bonus action, move the devil up to 30 feet in any direction. If it passes over sand, dust, loose dirt, or small gravel, it creates a 10-foot-radius heavily obscuring debris cloud around itself until the start of your next turn. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d8 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:earth-tremor.sourceBook: Xanathar's Guide to Everything/Elemental Evil Player's Companion
wikidot5e:spell:earth-tremor.description: Each other creature on the ground within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and falls prone. Loose earth or stone in the area becomes difficult terrain until cleared. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:earthbind.name: Earthbind
wikidot5e:spell:earthbind.description: One visible creature in range makes a Strength save. On a failure, its flying speed becomes 0 for the duration. An affected airborne creature descends at 60 feet per round until it reaches the ground or the spell ends.

wikidot5e:spell:elemental-bane.name: Elemental Bane
wikidot5e:spell:elemental-bane.description: Choose one visible creature in range and acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target makes a Constitution save; on a failure, for the duration it loses resistance to the chosen damage type and the first time each turn it takes that type of damage it takes an extra 2d6 of that type. Each slot level above 4th lets you target one additional creature, with all targets within 30 feet of one another when chosen.

wikidot5e:spell:enhance-ability.name: Enhance Ability
components: M (fur or a feather from a beast)
wikidot5e:spell:enhance-ability.description: Touch a creature and choose one benefit for the duration. Bear's Endurance gives advantage on Constitution checks and 2d6 temporary hit points that disappear when the spell ends. Bull's Strength gives advantage on Strength checks and doubles carrying capacity. Cat's Grace gives advantage on Dexterity checks and prevents falling damage from falls of 20 feet or less while not incapacitated. Eagle's Splendor gives advantage on Charisma checks. Fox's Cunning gives advantage on Intelligence checks. Owl's Wisdom gives advantage on Wisdom checks. Each slot level above 2nd lets you target one additional creature.

wikidot5e:spell:entangle.name: Entangle
wikidot5e:spell:entangle.description: Weeds and vines fill a 20-foot square on the ground starting at a point within range, making it difficult terrain for the duration. Each creature in the area when you cast makes a Strength save or is restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, freeing itself on a success. The conjured plants wilt when the spell ends.

The ground there becomes difficult terrain until cleared, with each 5-foot square taking at least 1 minute to clear by hand. Each slot level above 3rd adds 1d12 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:faerie-fire.name: Faerie Fire
wikidot5e:spell:faerie-fire.description: Objects in a 20-foot cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Creatures in the area make Dexterity saves and are also outlined on a failure. For the duration, outlined targets shed dim light in a 10-foot radius, cannot benefit from invisibility, and attacks against them have advantage when the attacker can see them.

wikidot5e:spell:feign-death.name: Feign Death
wikidot5e:spell:feign-death.description: A willing creature you touch enters a state indistinguishable from death for 1 hour or until you use an action to touch it and dismiss the spell. It appears dead to outward inspection and magic used to determine its status, is blinded and incapacitated, has speed 0, and has resistance to all damage except psychic. Diseases and poisons affecting it, or acquired during the spell, have no effect until the spell ends.

wikidot5e:spell:find-traps.name: Find Traps
wikidot5e:spell:find-traps.description: Sense whether any deliberately created trap within line of sight and 120 feet is present. A trap is something intentionally designed to cause a sudden or unexpected harmful or undesirable effect, including alarm, glyph of warding, or a mechanical pit, but not natural hazards such as a weak floor or sinkhole. You learn that a trap is present and the general nature of its danger, but not each trap's location.

wikidot5e:spell:flame-arrows.name: Flame Arrows
wikidot5e:spell:flame-arrows.description: Touch a quiver of arrows or bolts. A ranged weapon hit using ammunition drawn from it deals an extra 1d6 fire damage; the magic ends on that ammunition whether the attack hits or misses. The spell ends after twelve pieces of ammunition have been drawn. Each slot level above 3rd increases the number of affected pieces by two.

wikidot5e:spell:flame-blade.name: Flame Blade
wikidot5e:spell:flame-blade.description: Create a fiery scimitar-like blade in your free hand for the duration. If released it disappears, and you can recreate it as a bonus action. As an action, make a melee spell attack with it; on a hit it deals 3d6 fire damage. It sheds bright light for 10 feet and dim light for another 10 feet. For every two slot levels above 2nd, the damage increases by 1d6.

wikidot5e:spell:flaming-sphere.name: Flaming Sphere
components: M (a bit of tallow, a pinch of brimstone, and a dusting of powdered iron)
wikidot5e:spell:flaming-sphere.description: Create a 5-foot-diameter fiery sphere in an unoccupied space within range. A creature ending its turn within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. As a bonus action, move the sphere up to 30 feet; if you ram it into a creature, that creature makes the save and the sphere stops for the turn. The sphere can move over barriers up to 5 feet high and jump pits up to 10 feet wide, ignites unattended flammable objects, and sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:fog-cloud.description: Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. wikidot5e:spell:freedom-of-movement.name: Freedom of Movement
components: M (a leather strap, bound around the arm or a similar appendage)
wikidot5e:spell:freedom-of-movement.description: For 1 hour, a willing creature you touch ignores difficult terrain; spells and other magical effects cannot reduce its speed or make it paralyzed or restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape nonmagical restraints such as manacles or a grapple. Being underwater imposes no penalties on its movement or attacks.

wikidot5e:spell:geas.name: Geas
wikidot5e:spell:geas.description: Give one visible creature that understands you a command to perform or avoid a course of action. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 30 days. While charmed, directly acting against your instructions causes 5d10 psychic damage, at most once per day. A command that would certainly cause its death ends the spell. You can dismiss the spell as an action, and remove curse, greater restoration, or wish also ends it. A 7th- or 8th-level slot lasts 1 year; a 9th-level slot lasts until ended by one of those methods.

wikidot5e:spell:giant-insect.name: Giant Insect
wikidot5e:spell:giant-insect.description: Transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into the corresponding giant creatures for up to 10 minutes. They obey your verbal commands, act on your turn in combat, and use the published giant-creature statistics. A transformed creature returns to normal when the spell ends, it reaches 0 HP, or you dismiss its transformation as an action. The DM may allow analogous insects using an appropriate giant stat block.

wikidot5e:spell:grasping-vine.description: Conjure a vine in a visible unoccupied ground space within 30 feet. When cast, and as a bonus action on each later turn, choose a visible creature within 30 feet of the vine; it makes a Dexterity save or is pulled 20 feet directly toward the vine.

wikidot5e:spell:guardian-of-nature.name: Guardian of Nature
wikidot5e:spell:guardian-of-nature.description: Transform yourself for up to 1 minute as either a Primal Beast or Great Tree. wikidot5e:spell:guidance.name: Guidance
wikidot5e:spell:guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

wikidot5e:spell:guiding-hand-ua.name: Guiding Hand (UA)
wikidot5e:spell:guiding-hand-ua.description: Create a Tiny incorporeal hand of light within 5 feet for up to 8 hours; it vanishes if you teleport or change planes. An expelled creature falls prone in the nearest unoccupied space to the entry point.

wikidot5e:spell:protection-from-energy.name: Protection from Energy
wikidot5e:spell:protection-from-energy.description: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

wikidot5e:spell:protection-from-poison.description: Touch one creature. If it is poisoned, neutralize one poison affecting it—one you know is present, or a random one if several exist. For 1 hour, the target also has advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.

wikidot5e:spell:purify-food-and-drink.description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

wikidot5e:spell:reincarnate.name: Reincarnate
components: M (rare oils and unguents worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
wikidot5e:spell:reincarnate.description: Touch a dead humanoid or a piece of one that died no more than 10 days ago. wikidot5e:spell:scrying.name: Scrying
components: M (a focus worth at least 1,000 gp, such as a crystal ball, a silver mirror, or a font filled with holy water)
wikidot5e:spell:scrying.description: Observe a chosen creature on your plane for up to 10 minutes. wikidot5e:spell:skywrite.name: Skywrite
wikidot5e:spell:skywrite.description: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The words appear to be made of cloud and remain in place for the spell’s duration. The words dissipate when the spell ends. A strong wind can disperse the clouds and end the spell early.

wikidot5e:spell:sleet-storm.name: Sleet Storm

wikidot5e:spell:snare.name: Snare

After triggering, the spell ends once no creature remains restrained.

wikidot5e:spell:wall-of-stone.description: Create a nonmagical stone wall within 120 feet for up to 10 minutes from ten contiguous 10-by-10-foot panels 6 inches thick, or ten 10-by-20-foot panels 3 inches thick. Maintaining concentration for the full duration makes the wall permanent and no longer dispellable.

Cold-damage spells passing through freeze at least a 5-foot-square section; each frozen section has AC 5 and 15 HP, and when destroyed it leaves a permanent gap that the remaining water does not refill.

wikidot5e:spell:warding-wind.name: Warding Wind
wikidot5e:spell:warding-wind.description: A 20-mph wind blows in a 10-foot radius around you and moves with you for up to 10 minutes. It deafens creatures in the area, extinguishes unprotected torch-sized or smaller flames, makes the area difficult terrain for creatures other than you, imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks passing into or out of it, and disperses vapor, gas, and fog that strong wind can disperse.

wikidot5e:spell:water-walk.description: Up to ten willing visible creatures within 30 feet can move across liquid surfaces such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava as though on harmless solid ground for 1 hour, though environmental hazards such as lava heat still apply. wikidot5e:spell:watery-sphere.name: Watery Sphere
wikidot5e:spell:watery-sphere.description: Create a 5-foot-radius water sphere at a visible point within 90 feet, hovering no more than 10 feet above the ground for up to 1 minute. A creature in its space makes a Strength save; Huge or larger succeeds automatically. On success it is ejected to the nearest open space; on failure it is restrained and engulfed, repeating the save at the end of each turn. The sphere can hold at most four Medium-or-smaller creatures or one Large creature, ejecting a random previously restrained creature if over capacity. As an action, move it up to 30 feet in a straight line; it descends safely over drops, carries restrained creatures, and can ram creatures to force the save at most once per turn. When the spell ends, the sphere falls, extinguishes normal flames within 30 feet, and knocks restrained creatures prone where it lands.

wikidot5e:spell:wild-cunning.name: Wild Cunning (UA)
wikidot5e:spell:wild-cunning.description: Choose one nature-aid effect within 120 feet: learn the location of all ground tracks and gain advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to follow them for 1 hour or until you cast the spell again; learn the location of edible forage; learn the location of clean drinking water; learn the location of suitable shelter; have spirits gather firewood and set up a campsite using your supplies; or have spirits instantly break down a campsite, including extinguishing the fire, packing gear, and burying rubbish.

wikidot5e:spell:wind-wall.name: Wind Wall
components: M (a tiny fan and a feather of exotic origin)
wikidot5e:spell:wind-wall.description: Create a continuous wall of strong wind rising from the ground within 120 feet, up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick, for up to 1 minute. Creatures in its area when it appears make Strength saves for 3d8 bludgeoning damage, half on success. The wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases away; blocks Small-or-smaller flying creatures and objects and gaseous-form creatures; throws loose light materials upward; and automatically deflects ordinary arrows, bolts, and similar projectiles aimed through it, though very heavy projectiles are unaffected.

wikidot5e:spell:wither-and-bloom.name: Wither and Bloom
components: M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
wikidot5e:spell:wither-and-bloom.description: Choose a 10-foot-radius sphere centered within 60 feet. Creatures of your choice there make Constitution saves, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success; nonmagical vegetation withers. One creature of your choice in the area may spend and roll one unspent Hit Die and regain HP equal to the roll plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d6 damage and lets the healing target spend one additional Hit Die and add it to the healing roll.

wikidot5e:spell:wrath-of-nature.name: Wrath Of Nature
wikidot5e:spell:wrath-of-nature.description: Animate nature in a 60-foot cube centered within 120 feet for up to 1 minute. Grass and undergrowth become difficult terrain for your enemies. At the start of each of your turns, each enemy within 10 feet of a tree makes a Dexterity save or takes 4d6 slashing damage. At the end of each of your turns, one grounded creature you choose in the cube makes a Strength save or is restrained until the spell ends; it can use an action for a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to escape. As a bonus action, launch one loose rock in the cube with a ranged spell attack; on a hit it deals 3d8 nonmagical bludgeoning damage and the target makes a Strength save or falls prone.
